extract.en: Fountains in Versailles were filled with orange blossom water, and royal furniture was sprayed with lavender and rose extracts.
extract.zh: 凡尔赛宫的喷泉里注满了橙花水，皇家家具上喷洒了薰衣草和玫瑰提取物。

execution.en: They used to host mock battles, executions, and dramatic performances inside the Colosseum.
execution.zh: 他们过去常常在斗兽场内举办模拟海战、处决和戏剧表演。

execution.en: Anyway, after the execution of King Charles I, England became a republic, with Cromwell at its head.
execution.zh: 总之，在 Charles I 被处决后，英格兰成为了共和国，由 Cromwell 领导。

execution.en: He became more ruthless in battle. He authorised brutal reprisals against Ottoman troops, including the execution of prisoners.
execution.zh: 他在战斗中变得更加冷酷无情。他授权对奥斯曼军队进行残暴的报复，包括处决战俘。

execution.en: Tens of thousands of civilians were killed, and reports of war crimes, including torture and summary executions, were widespread.
execution.zh: 数万名平民丧生，有关酷刑和即决处决等战争罪行的报道比比皆是。

execution.en: Public executions were staged to send a message.
execution.zh: 公开处决被用来杀鸡儆猴。

extensive.en: Nevertheless, he had a deep sense of patriotism, he had extensive military and leadership experience, and he believed his country needed him.
extensive.zh: 尽管如此，他有着强烈的爱国主义精神，拥有丰富的军事和领导经验，并且他相信祖国需要他。

extensive.en: And again, fortunately for our story, the 1870s was not a time of extensive background checks and synchronised criminal databases, so Earp was able to get various jobs as a lawman, a sort of police officer.
extensive.zh: 同样幸运的是,19世纪70年代还没有严格的背景调查和联网的犯罪数据库，所以 Earp 后来还能陆续谋得几份执法官(相当于警察)的工作。

extensive.en: You might already use the tool that we’ve been building, FixMyEnglish.ai, which does a similar thing, but recreates the experience you might have had with a brilliant teacher, where they cross out all of your mistakes in red pen and write extensive explanations, so that you learn from every mistake.
extensive.zh: 你可能已经在使用了我们一直在构建的工具 FixMyEnglish.ai，它做的事情类似，但重现了你与一位优秀老师交流的体验，老师会用红笔划掉你所有的错误并写下详细的解释，这样你就能从每一个错误中吸取教训。

expel.en: What they started was a disciplinary hearing, and they were expelled the same afternoon.
expel.zh: 然而他们引发的是一场纪律听证会，当天下午他们就被开除了。

expel.en: When he was expelled, Diarmait did what many rulers in trouble do: he went looking for allies.
expel.zh: 被驱逐后，Diarmait 做了许多陷入困境的统治者都会做的事：寻找盟友。

expel.en: But in 1811, he was expelled from Oxford University for publishing a short pamphlet called "The Necessity of Atheism."
expel.zh: 但在 1811 年，他因出版一本名为《无神论的必要性》的小册子而被牛津大学开除。

expel.en: He had been expelled by the High King of Ireland, with the backing of a rival chieftain named Tigernán Ua Ruairc — a man with a very personal reason to want Diarmait gone.
expel.zh: 他被爱尔兰至尊王驱逐了，背后支持者是一位名叫 Tigernán Ua Ruairc 的敌对酋长——此人有一个非常私人的理由想要赶走 Diarmait。

exile.en: Almost five centuries earlier, the exiled King Diarmait had invited the English over to Ireland.
exile.zh: 大约五个世纪前，流亡国王 Diarmait 邀请英国人来到爱尔兰。

exile.en: He cracked down on dissent, exiling or imprisoning those who opposed his vision.
exile.zh: 他严厉打击异见，将那些反对他愿景的人流放或关入监狱。

exile.en: He entered politics, tried to reform Carthage, and later went into exile.
exile.zh: 他投身政治，试图改革迦太基，后来被迫流亡。

exile.en: Now, despite the fact that he had been exiled from Carthaginian society, Rome never forgot him.
exile.zh: 尽管他后来被迦太基社会流放，但罗马人从未忘记他。

exile.en: If you were loyal, you were rewarded. If you weren’t, you were either exiled, imprisoned, or worse.
exile.zh: 如果你忠诚，你就会得到奖励。如果你不忠，你就会被流放、监禁，甚至更惨。

exclude.en: If you do, make sure everyone understands what you said, so no one feels excluded.
exclude.zh: 如果你这样做了，请确保每个人都听懂了你所说的话，这样就不会有人感到被排挤了。

exclude.en: She did all of this at a time when women were largely excluded from science.
exclude.zh: 她所有这一切都是在女性被大面积排除在科学界之外的时期完成的。

exclude.en: Jewish people and other persecuted groups were systematically excluded from public life.
exclude.zh: 犹太人和其他受迫害的群体被系统地排挤出公众生活。

exclude.en: The current proposal is careful to exclude the most serious crimes.
exclude.zh: 目前的提案很谨慎地把最严重的罪行排除在外。

exclude.en: Under Ottoman rule, women had been largely excluded from public life.
exclude.zh: 在奥斯曼统治下，女性基本上被排除在公共生活之外。

extension.en: It protected the established Church of England and, by extension, the political order that rested upon it.
extension.zh: 它保护了既定的英格兰教会，并由此延伸，保护了赖以建立的政治秩序。

extension.en: Follow-up questions are a natural extension of this.
extension.zh: 后续问题（跟进提问）是这种提问的自然延伸。

extension.en: Last year, I built a Chrome Extension that helps people learn new English vocabulary, as well as a tool that gives you feedback on your written English, and both of those were “vibe-coded”.
extension.zh: 去年，我做了一个帮助大家学习新英语词汇的 Chrome 扩展，还做了一个能对你的英语写作给出反馈的工具，这两个都是“vibe-coded”出来的。

extraordinarily.en: And crucially for our story, North Korea is extraordinarily sensitive about its image.
extraordinarily.zh: 而对我们这个故事来说至关重要的一点是，朝鲜对自己的形象极度敏感。

exception.en: Most of the overseas collectivities are not in the EU, with, I think, one exception.
exception.zh: 大多数海外集体都不在欧盟内，我想只有一个例外。

exception.en: There are some clear exceptions, like business decisions or fact checking.
exception.zh: 有一些明显的例外，比如商业决策或事实核查。

exception.en: There are exceptions, but there was a strong overall trend.
exception.zh: 虽然存在例外，但总体趋势非常强烈。

exception.en: But, there are some exceptions to this natural elegance.
exception.zh: 但是，这种自然的优雅也有一些例外。

exception.en: England is no exception, although the line between north and south is not nearly as clear as some people might think it is.
exception.zh: 英格兰也不例外，尽管南北之间的界线远没有某些人想象的那么分明。

excess.en: What replaced him was a ruler who seemed to revel in cruelty, humiliation, and excess.
excess.zh: 取代他的是一个似乎以残忍、羞辱和无节制为乐的统治者。

excess.en: And it is a well-deserved reputation. Because while the Romans indulged in excess, and the Middle East perfected the science, it was in France that perfume became an art form.
excess.zh: 而且这个声誉实至名归。因为虽然罗马人沉溺于穷奢极欲，中东人完善了科学，但正是在法国，香水变成了一门艺术。

excess.en: He developed a reputation for being the prince who got things done, who followed up, who didn’t disappear into luxury or lose himself in excess, something of a rare trait for a young, Saudi prince.
excess.zh: 他树立了一种名声：办事雷厉风行、善始善终、不会沉溺于奢华或过度放纵，这在年轻的沙特王子中算是一种罕见的品质。

explosive.en: He built explosive components from scratch.
explosive.zh: 他从零开始制造爆炸物组件。

explosive.en: They took out the spare shirt, but they were more interested in what the shirt was wrapped around: two sticks of plastic explosives, two bombs.
explosive.zh: 他们拿出了备用衬衫，但他们更关心的是衬衫包裹的东西：两根塑胶炸药，也就是两枚炸弹。

explosive.en: He was part of it. He fought alongside the Arab soldiers, not just hanging back sipping tea and advising the prince, but on the frontlines, leading guerilla missions, setting off explosives, and getting involved in a far more active way than he was meant to.
explosive.zh: 他是其中的一员。他与阿拉伯士兵并肩作战，不只是躲在后面喝茶给王子出主意，而是身处前线，领导游击任务，引爆炸药，以一种远超他职责范围的积极方式参与其中。

explosion.en: No, no planes had been seen, and there were no other explosions.
explosion.zh: 不，没有看到飞机，也没有发生其他爆炸。

explosion.en: At first, von Stauffenberg insisted, “I saw the explosion.
explosion.zh: 起初，冯·施陶芬贝格坚称：“我看到了爆炸。

explosion.en: The explosion and subsequent fire at the Chernobyl plant spread radiation across Europe and caused untold health, environmental, and social impacts.
explosion.zh: 切尔诺贝利电站的爆炸以及随后的火灾将辐射散播到整个欧洲，并造成了难以估量的健康、环境和社会影响。

explosion.en: These elements were created during supernova explosions and collisions of neutron stars—cosmic events that forge the universe’s heaviest and most valuable materials.
explosion.zh: 这些元素是在超新星爆炸和中子星碰撞过程中产生的——这些宇宙事件锻造出了宇宙中最重、最有价值的物质。

explosion.en: In an atomic bomb, with a large concentration of highly enriched Uranium-235, this causes a huge, destructive explosion, but if it could be done with uranium that was less enriched, then the energy given out by the reaction could be controlled and converted into usable energy.
explosion.zh: 在原子弹中，由于高度浓缩的铀-235高度集中，这会引起巨大的、具有毁灭性的爆炸，但如果使用的是浓缩程度较低的铀，那么反应释放出的能量就可以得到控制，并转化为可用的能源。

exploration.en: OK then, let’s not waste a minute and learn about the history of underwater exploration.
exploration.zh: 好了，那我们一分钟也不要浪费，一起来了解水下探索的历史吧。

exploration.en: Other historians argue that exploration itself was a central part of Polynesian culture.
exploration.zh: 另一些历史学家则认为，探索本身就是波利尼西亚文化的核心部分。

exploration.en: These men own or control companies that shape everything from space exploration and AI development to the media.
exploration.zh: 这些人拥有或控制着塑造从太空探索、人工智能发展到媒体等各个领域的公司。

exploration.en: So, to start off this exploration of the science of leap years, we need to go back to the start.
exploration.zh: 因此，要开始对闰年科学的探索，我们需要回到最初。

exploration.en: Exploration was the ultimate frontier, and it promised fortune, glory, and the chance to write your name into history.
exploration.zh: 探索是终极的前沿，它承诺带来财富、荣耀，以及将你的名字写入历史的机会。

excellent.en: Britain also has excellent seafood. There’s also great meat in the UK, a lot of free-range animals.
excellent.zh: 英国也有极好的海鲜。英国还有很棒的肉类，有很多放养的动物。

excellent.en: He had always been a smart student and managed to get excellent grades without doing too much work.
excellent.zh: 他一直是个聪明的学生，不用花太多精力就能取得优异的成绩。

excellent.en: There are some genuinely excellent ingredients available in Britain.
excellent.zh: 英国有一些真正优秀的食材。

excellent.en: But that is not necessarily the case. Over the years, I’ve met English learners with excellent English, but who were afraid to speak.
excellent.zh: 但事实并非如此。这些年来，我遇到过许多英语水平极佳，却害怕开口的英语学习者。

exploitation.en: This was also the result of violence and exploitation, and neglect.
exploitation.zh: 这也是暴力、剥削和忽视所导致的后果。

exploitation.en: To some, this is a worthy achievement, a law that protects workers from exploitation at the hands of greedy corporations.
exploitation.zh: 对某些人来说，这是一项了不起的成就，是一部保护工人免受贪婪公司剥削的法律。

exploitation.en: Christmas Island is a tropical paradise with a history of colonial exploitation, forced labor, wartime occupation, and a controversial refugee detention program.
exploitation.zh: 圣诞岛是一个热带天堂，却有着一段殖民剥削、强迫劳动、战时占领以及充满争议的难民拘留计划的历史。

exploitation.en: Or is it not? In 2015, Barack Obama signed something called the SPACE Act, which gives U.S. citizens the right to "engage in the commercial exploration and exploitation of 'space resources' [including... water and minerals] ".
exploitation.zh: 还是说并不是这样？2015 年，贝拉克·奥巴马签署了一项名为《太空法案》的文件，赋予了美国公民“从事‘太空资源’[包括……水和矿物]商业勘探和开发的权利”。

excessive.en: Excessive risk taking, overconfidence, lack of regulation, and a sudden loss of trust.
excessive.zh: 过度冒险、过度自信、缺乏监管以及信任的突然丧失。

excessive.en: Of course, confidence can sometimes be excessive.
excessive.zh: 当然，自信有时也可能过头。

excessive.en: On the right, there are those who oppose it because they see it as excessive government intervention in the free market, something that distorts natural supply and demand and risks killing jobs.
excessive.zh: 在右翼，有人反对它，因为他们认为这是政府对自由市场的过度干预，扭曲了自然的供求关系，并有减少就业机会的风险。

exclusively.en: Within the area around your country, you are allowed to exclusively fish, use the resources in the ocean.
exclusively.zh: 在贵国周围的区域内，您被允许专有捕鱼、利用海洋资源。

exclusively.en: These servants were witches, people, almost exclusively women, who had made a pact with Satan, a deal with the devil.
exclusively.zh: 这些仆从就是女巫，也就是几乎全为女性的人，她们与撒旦立了契约，与魔鬼做了交易。

exclusively.en: I get on really well with my mother-in-law, my father-in-law, and my sister-in-law, and my brother-in-law, and all of that is done exclusively in Japanese as well.
exclusively.zh: 我和岳母、岳父、小姨子、小叔子都相处得很好，而且所有这些交流也完全是用日语进行的。

exclusively.en: The cafe also turned into a bar, so at nights I would go and meet more people and chat with people, and it was all 100% exclusively in Japanese.
exclusively.zh: 这家咖啡馆后来也变成了一家酒吧，所以晚上我会去结识更多人并和大家聊天，而且全程100%只用日语。

exclusively.en: When I was studying in Japan, I was not studying Japanese technically, I was a research student, but I did take a Japanese class and I talked exclusively in Japanese to everyone in that classroom.
exclusively.zh: 我在日本学习时，严格来说我不是在学日语，我是一名研究生，但我确实上过日语课，而且我在那个教室里和所有人都只用日语交流。

extraction.en: They perfected distillation, which is a technique that allowed for the extraction of pure, concentrated scents, and is still a method used in modern perfume-making.
extraction.zh: 他们完善了蒸馏技术，这是一种能够提取纯净、浓缩香味的技术，至今仍是现代香水制造中使用的方法。

extraction.en: Still, there are some commentators who have pointed out that, even with a relatively small haul of precious metals, asteroid mining could be very detrimental to lower-income countries that have so-far relied on natural resource extraction.
extraction.zh: 尽管如此，一些评论员指出，即使带着相对较少量的贵金属，小行星采矿也可能对迄今为止一直依赖自然资源开采的低收入国家造成极大损害。

expedition.en: Despite the countless expeditions launched to uncover the truth, Fawcett’s remains have never been identified.
expedition.zh: 尽管为了揭开真相发起了无数次远征，Fawcett 的遗骸却从未被确认过。

expedition.en: On the 1st of January 1502, a Portuguese expedition sailed into Guanabara Bay.
expedition.zh: 1502年1月1日，一支葡萄牙探险队驶入瓜纳巴拉湾。

expedition.en: Anyway, in 1521 he was a couple of years into his expedition, and he was in the middle of the vast Pacific Ocean.
expedition.zh: 无论如何，在1521年，他的远征已经进行了好几年，当时他正身处浩瀚的太平洋中央。

expedition.en: When he was 22 years old, Charles Darwin received an invitation to join a global expedition aboard a British Navy ship called HMS Beagle.
expedition.zh: 22岁时，Charles Darwin收到了一份邀请，登上了一艘名为HMS Beagle的英国海军舰艇，参与环球考察。

expedition.en: But 150 years ago, it was in the business of “creating” geography, of sponsoring and supporting expeditions to explore, map and understand the natural world.
expedition.zh: 但在 150 年前，它的核心业务是“创造”地理，即赞助和支持旨在探索、绘制并了解自然世界的远征活动。

expansion.en: It became the southernmost point of Japan’s wartime expansion.
expansion.zh: 它成为了日本战时扩张的最南端。

expansion.en: This was a long process of migration and expansion.
expansion.zh: 这是一个漫长的迁徙与扩张过程。

expansion.en: Finally, expansion could happen and probably will happen.
expansion.zh: 最后，扩张可能会发生，而且很可能会发生。

expansion.en: The invasion, which was widely seen as an attempt to reassert Russia’s influence and challenge NATO’s expansion, has plunged relations between Russia and the West to their lowest point since the Cold War.
expansion.zh: 这场入侵被普遍视为重塑俄罗斯影响力并挑战北约扩张的企图，它将俄乌以及俄罗斯与西方国家的关系降到了冷战以来的最低点。

expansion.en: By discussing the history of Easter Island, we have also talked about Polynesian expansion, potential Polynesian contact in South America, the mystery of the Moai, colonialism, and the debate over the ownership of history.
expansion.zh: 通过讨论复活节岛的历史，我们也谈到了波利尼西亚人的扩张、可能存在的波利尼西亚与南美洲接触、Moai 的谜团、殖民主义，以及关于历史所有权的争论。

extinguish.en: Whether these groups are as powerful as some people believe or simply ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances, One thing is certain: nothing these groups say or do will ever fully extinguish the belief in their secrets; for some, the mystery is simply too enticing to let go.
extinguish.zh: 无论这些组织是否如某些人想象的那样强大，还是只是不寻常环境下的普通人，有一点是确定的：这些组织所说或所做的一切，永远无法彻底扑灭人们对其秘密的信念；对某些人来说，这种神秘感实在是太诱人了，让人欲罢不能。

experimentation.en: But he did do a lot of experiments. He did lots of experimentation, lots of observation.
experimentation.zh: 但他确实做了很多实验。他做了大量的实验，进行了大量的观察。

experimentation.en: Science is based on observation, experimentation, and evidence.
experimentation.zh: 科学的基础是观察、实验和证据。

exempt.en: Potentially highly skilled workers, especially those earning higher salaries, or people working in public sector roles like healthcare and teaching, or perhaps people on family visas, especially those who are family members of British citizens, maybe they will be exempt from waiting a full 10 years.
exempt.zh: 潜在的高技能人才，特别是那些收入较高的人，或者在医疗和教学等公共部门角色中工作的人，或者可能是持有家庭签证的人——尤其是英国公民的家庭成员，也许他们可以免除满10年的等待。

experimental.en: So the Curie family were a group of incredibly respected and successful experimental scientists.
experimental.zh: 所以居里家族是一群备受尊敬且极为成功的实验科学家。

experimental.en: In Paris Marie met Pierre Curie, a physicist who shared her deep interest in experimental science.
experimental.zh: 在巴黎，玛丽遇到了 Pierre Curie，一位与她同样对实验科学有着浓厚兴趣的物理学家。
